operations.comment: ; Captain Skyhawk (NES, Milton Bradley / Rare 1989) - commented ca65 disassembly
; ROMAtlas commentary source; rebuilt byte-identically from commentary/source.
; Original bytes for data regions are taken from the local image.nes (never shared).
; Cartridge: mapper 7 (AxROM), 4 x 32 KiB PRG banks, 8 KiB CHR-RAM, one-screen mirroring.
; Bank-select values: a write of value V to $8000-$FFFF selects PRG bank V&7 and the
; one-screen nametable page from bit 4. To avoid bus conflicts every bank contains a
; 20-byte table whose byte n equals n (BankSelectTable_Bn), and code writes the value
; by storing to that table entry ("sta BankSelectTable_B0+$10" = bank 0, screen page 1).
; RAM CurBankSel/FarBankSel hold such table indices ($00-$03 / $10-$13).
;   bank 0  main program: reset/NMI, frame state machine, flight engine, HUD, sound
;           driver, attract/title/high-score screens, text and graphics helpers.
;   bank 1  screen/graphics loaders (CHR-RAM uploads, nametable/attribute builders)
;   bank 2  outer-space mission phase (enemy ships, lock-on missiles), VRAM block
;           decoder and RAM VRAM-copy routine image.
;   bank 3  ground-flight object engine (enemy scripts, bullets, bombs, missiles,
;           explosions), terrain decoding/scrolling, joypad reader, shop text,
;   * Frame state machine: a screen handler ends its frame with
;     The NMI handler (bank 0 NmiHandler) resets the stack and jumps through
;     FrameHandler, so each handler runs once per video frame from a clean stack.
;   * Far call: "lda #banksel / sta FarBankSel / lda #<FarN_Slot / jsr FarCall".
;     FarCall stores the slot offset in FarCallVector, swaps CurBankSel/FarBankSel,
;     selects the bank and calls $8000 = "jmp (FarCallVector)" in that bank, which
;     lands on a 3-byte JMP slot (labels FarN_<target>). The caller's bank is
;     restored on return. Each bank carries its own copy of the stub at $FFD2.
;   * Labels NoCaller_*/Bypassed* (and MulSignedB3) mark small code ranges that
;     are statically code but have no known caller (maps pass-002/003, leads
;     L006-L009); their comments describe what they would do, not observed use.
; Names and comments are interpretations from static code reading plus round-1
; traces and the redirect progression scenarios S07-S13 (space battle,
; docking, shop, final base attack, ending, carrier landing, objective block
; swap); tentative wording marks uncertain meaning. The phase-1 map (pass-003)
; classifies every byte. Data labels FillBn_XXXX / <Table>_FillXXXX name uniform
; fill runs (unreferenced padding / runs inside a table); open questions are
; ---- RAM symbols (CPU $0000-$07FF; names are interpretations, see comments) ----
; 2 bytes. points still to be added to the score display (16-bit, drained by AddPendingScore)
; remaining lives (5 at a new game, 10 max; title cheat gives 10)
; 7 bytes. score as 7 tile codes ($F6 = '0'); $04 is the least significant digit
; current terrain section id (selects the map section; $1C/$2C/$44 special)
; invulnerability frames after a (re)start; $FE = permanent (title code cheat)
; shop credits earned by destroying targets (0-99)
; BCD ones digit of Credits (for the HUD)
; AIM-54 Phoenix air-to-air missile stock (0-4; shop item; used in space)
; Maverick AGM air-to-ground missile stock (0-12; shop item)
; cannon upgrade level (0-4; shortens the fire repeat delay)
; continues left at game over (3 at a new game)
; value rewritten to PPUCTRL by the NMI handler
; increments once per handled frame; also used as a general timer
; 2 bytes. jmp ($0018) target; low byte = far slot, high byte fixed at $80
; controller 1 buttons held (A=$80 B=$40 Sel=$20 Start=$10 U=$08 D=$04 L=$02 R=$01)
; controller 1 buttons newly pressed this frame
; controller 2 held buttons; also reused as the "next phase" code ($44/$48/$88) passed to MissionStart
; 2 bytes. raw shift registers used while reading both controllers
; 2 bytes. address the NMI handler jumps to (current screen/frame handler)
; bank-select table index of the bank currently mapped
; bank-select table index used by the next FarCall
; 2 bytes. second data pointer (terrain section list)
; 3-frame work phase (2,1,0) used to spread uploads over frames
; flips every 3-frame cycle (alternates plane sprite sets)
; index used by the RAM VRAM-copy routine for the plane graphics frame
; 2 bytes. PPU address (hi,lo) for the next plane graphics upload
; UpdateStars scratch (low nibble of the star's cell/position byte)
; frame requested by the flight model
; signed climb/descent step derived from PitchStep
; player plane screen Y / altitude ($90 = on the ground/deck level)
; signed bank/roll value driven by left/right
; nose pitch (Down raises, Up lowers; clamped per phase)
; non-zero while the take-off sequence runs
; 0 = ground flight; 1 = space/docking phase; 3 = set by the ending path
; 0 running, 1 paused (sound muted), 2 = phase finished request
; latched left/right input while Select is held
; DrawPlaneShadow scratch: shadow base Y before the terrain-height offset
; 2 bytes. vertical scroll used by briefing/ending screens
; vertical PPUSCROLL value for the play field
; 2 bytes. terrain scroll position (wraps at $3C0 per section)
; 2 bytes. vertical scroll speed (integer, fraction) derived from Speed
; set to 3 with VertSpeed when the plane is reset; no direct reader found
; horizontal drift given to new bullets
; frames until the cannon may fire again
; 2 bytes. fuel counter (16-bit, counts down each frame; empty causes a crash)
; 2 bytes. PPU address for the next terrain row/column upload
; screen Y of the bottom clip line for sprites
; copy of AttractTimer high byte used by the title effect
; 2 bytes. horizontal world position low byte; high part in WorldXHi
; 4 bytes. title/attract effect VRAM pointer and step
; next free OAM buffer byte (sprite allocation cursor)
; set while the plane sits at deck level
; set to $3E at mission start; no direct reader found
; attribute bits ORed into metasprite tiles (flip)
; delay counter after a throttle change
; end-of-ground-mission climb-out; 0 normal, 1 landed on the pad marker or controller-2 B+Up, 2 objective reached elsewhere
; timing for the HUD split (scanline delay count)
; shop menu page (0 main, 1-4 item pages)
; selects the ending branch of the HUD split handler (tentative)
; 0 flying; $75-$7E docking sequence (B pressed while docking); $80-$87 crash sequence; set to $80 when hit or when docking fails
; space-phase sub mode (bit 7 = space battle, 1 = docking approach)
; horizontal drift index derived from Roll
; climb rate from the pitch table
; terrain map column of the plane
; 2 bytes. terrain map row of the plane (16-bit)
; cleared with MapRow at section start; no direct reader found
; 2 bytes. source pointer for the RAM RLE decoder (also scratch)
; bit 7 set on frames where note timers advance
; 2 bytes. sound command dispatch vector (also scratch)
; 2 bytes. PPU address for the next terrain column upload (lo, hi)
; 2 bytes. horizontal scroll speed (signed integer, fraction)
; 2x2 tile sub-column select during terrain decode
; 2x2 tile sub-row select during terrain decode
; current terrain block id during decode
; space phase: index of the locked-on enemy ($FF none)
; terrain height/attribute code under the plane (bit7 = high obstacle)
; name-entry wheel spin scratch (shift/rotate work byte)
; 2 bytes. space objects: X velocity per object
; 2 bytes. space objects: Y velocity per object
; 2 bytes. space objects: Y velocity fraction
; 10 bytes. special enemy record. Bank 2 (space): +0 X, +2 Y, +7 state ($FF none). Bank 3 (ground jet): +0/+1 X frac/int, +2/+3 Y frac/int, +5 speed, +8 altitude, +9 altitude step
; 2 bytes. terrain decode pointer (block -> tile table)
; counts frames without steering input (auto-centres pitch)
; 256 bytes. CPU stack; low part also used as a buffer (high-score rows, $0100 Mission save) and, via TXS tricks, as a fast VRAM copy buffer
; 6 bytes. ground sparkle effect timers (5 slots)
; section scroll fraction for object spawning
; last terrain row checked for object spawns
; OamBuffer+2-4: base for "sta OamAttrBaseM4,y" after Y += 4 (attribute byte)
; 256 bytes. sprite buffer copied by OAM DMA each NMI
; 230 bytes. star field (32 stars): +$06 X frac, +$26 X, +$46 Y frac, +$66 Y, +$86 phase, +$A6 dir, +$C6 speed
; 8 bytes. player bullets: screen Y ($F8 = free)
; 178 bytes. sound driver channel state (4 channels, stride 4; music $0406.., effects $0416..)
; 64 bytes. temporary buffer: terrain tile row/column; attract/credits effects and name entry use $04B8-$04BD as variables
; 16 bytes. object table: world X low (16 slots; space phase and name entry reuse $04F8-$0579 for their own movers)
; 16 bytes. object table: world X page 0-3 (ground) / screen X (space, name-entry wheel)
; 16 bytes. position within the movement script
; 16 bytes. frames until the next script step
; 2 bytes. space phase: per-enemy depth/approach value; name entry: wheel angle
; 32 bytes. palette buffer uploaded during NMI/frame handlers
; 5 bytes. homing missiles target object ($FF free, $FE bomb)
; 16 bytes. per-mission terrain block substitution table (blocks $F7-$FF)
; start of the $0600-$06FF variable page (cleared as a block by ClearRam)
; set to 2 when the plane touches terrain, counts down while it bounces off
; mission index 0-7 ($FF before the first briefing)
; index into the mission's terrain section list
; mission progress / stage flags (bit 7 = base attack, $40 = base finished)
; frames until the next space enemy
; 16 bytes. object group id (3 = none) used for group-kill bonuses
; shared animation frame for some object types
; shared animation frame for other object types
; 16 bytes. hits taken by multi-hit targets
; 3 bytes. bonus counter digits on the results screen
; last value written to SQ1_HI (engine sound)
; 11 bytes. banks 1/2 space-phase background cells (two sets at +$00/+$16, indexed by X)
; 21 bytes. enemy base part states (0 intact, 1-7 exploding, $FF destroyed)
; drift speed of the special object in slot 0
; 1 while a frame handler is still running (NMI then only runs the sound driver)
; block id last used for a height lookup (written by GroundUnder_Height; no direct reader found)
; 112 bytes. RAM copy of RamRleDecoderImage (RLE VRAM decoder)
; 7 bytes. best score of the current game (tiles), compared with the VRAM high-score table at game over
; 101 bytes. RAM copy of RamVramCopyImage (bank 2) - unrolled VRAM copy
; Reset entry (every bank's reset stub selects bank 0 and jumps here).
; Waits two vblanks, silences PPU/APU, clears RAM (keeping InvulnTimer), copies
; the RLE decoder image to RAM $0700 and sets FarCallVector's high byte.
; Warm-reset detection: the boot text is kept in nametable 0 at $2326. If the
; first four characters still match BootTextSignature the VRAM (including the
; high-score table stored in nametable 1) survived a reset and is not cleared;
; otherwise nametable 0 is cleared and the boot text is rewritten.
; Then loads palettes/CHR via far calls, draws the credits text (bank 3) and
; installs CreditsScatterFrame as the frame handler.
; VRAM char + $40 should equal the ASCII signature
; boot text is stored backwards; '.' and letters remapped to tiles
; chars below 'A' (digits): subtract $15; '0' maps to tile $0F
; Entered when the credits animation finishes (and after game over): silences
; the APU, starts title music (song 0) and falls into TitleScreenInit.
; Title screen ("MILTON BRADLEY PRESENTS / CAPTAIN SKYHAWK / PRESS START"):
; draws it with NMI-busy set, hides all sprites, loads title graphics from
; banks 2 and 1, initialises the star field and installs TitleFrame.
; Second attract screen (reached from TitleFrame when its timer reaches $83 and
; after the high-score table): clears CHR tiles $1FF/$EF, places a single plane
; sprite, loads palette (AttractPalette) and text, uploads 64 bytes of sprite
; tiles from AttractSpriteTiles to CHR $0F00 and installs AttractSceneFrame.
; Called when a crash sequence ends (CrashCounter reached 4). Unless this was
; the last life or the space phase is active, resets the per-life ground state
; (score sprites, objects, bullets, scroll speed), rewinds the terrain to the
; checkpoint position for the current TerrainSection (SectionCheckpoints) and
; rebuilds 27 terrain rows. Then resets the plane (launch sequence, pitch,
; speed, fuel, invulnerability) and decrements Lives: with lives left the
; frame loop continues, otherwise GameOverFadeStart follows.
; decode and upload one terrain row (27 rows before play resumes)
; A lone RTS directly after LoseLifeRestart's closing "jmp WaitForNmi".
; Nothing jumps here. Probably a leftover return from an edit to the routine
; above (the same pattern as $E0B7 and bank 3 $91B9). Statically classified as
; code with low confidence; never observed executing.
; Last life lost: sets FrameHandler to GameOverFadeFrame directly, stops the
; APU and enters that handler's split-and-wait part for the first frame.
; Starts a mission phase. Joy2Held holds the phase code chosen by the results
; screen: 0 = next mission (Mission is incremented), $88 = space battle after
; a completed ground mission, $44 = docking after the space battle, others
; restart the same mission. The code is copied into Joy2Held by
; Briefing_NextPhase just before the jump, so controller 2 cannot choose the
; starting phase (redirect S12). Clears RAM $0200-$06FF and zero page $16-$FF
; (keeping Mission, the code and InvulnTimer), resets the sound driver,
; initialises the flight variables, loads the mission graphics (bank 1/2
; loaders) and either pre-builds the first 27 terrain rows or prepares the
; missions 3 and 7 (index) start in terrain section $2C
; mission palette from MissionPalettes (4 bytes per mission)
; code $88: set up the space battle (bank 2)
; Frame handler of the title screen. Uploads the title palette faded by Temp0,
; sets scroll, burns time for the sprite/scroll timing, then advances the 16-bit
; AttractTimer by $33/frame. The high byte selects the fade level (fade in at
; the start, fade out near $7C-$87). Start jumps the timer to $84 (fade out).
; At $88 the game logo screen runs and then a new game starts; at $83 the
; attract scene follows. Also runs the sound driver and star field.
; identical copy of the TitleFrame_Delay path (taken when the low timer byte is positive)
; Start pressed: skip to the fade-out
; High-score table insert helper. The table lives in nametable VRAM at the rows
; listed in HighScoreRowAddr (8 entries, 15 bytes used per row). Moves rows
; from index 8 down to Temp1 one row down (via the stack page as a buffer),
; making room for a new entry at row Temp1.
; Frame handler of the attract scene. Cycles three palette entries in turn,
; scrolls/redraws parts of nametable rows (letters gathering effect driven by
; AttractTimer), moves 63 sprites along sine paths (SineTable, MulScaleC0),
; and returns to TitleScreenInit after 512 frames. Start goes to the logo
; copy 15 bytes of a nametable row through the stack page
; dissolve: clear one pixel column in CHR $1000-$13FF bytes along a pseudo-random walk
; masks $77/$BB/$DD/$EE each clear one pixel column (bit pair 7/3, 6/2, 5/1, 4/0)
; fold the phase into a triangle wave before the SineTable lookup
; wait for the sprite-0 hit before the mid-screen split
; same mask selection as the first dissolve loop
; Frame handler of the boot credits screen. Picks characters out of the
; credits text in VRAM and turns them into falling sprites (letter scatter),
; erasing them from the nametable. After two 256-frame periods it moves to
; TitleSequenceStart. Also watches controller 1 for a five-button code from
; CheatCodeButtons: when completed it sets InvulnTimer=$FE (permanent
; invulnerability) and shows greyscale as confirmation.
; sprite palette chosen by the character's screen row band
; off the bottom edge: park the sprite at Y $F8
; compare with the next expected code button
; Phase entered with code $44 after the space battle (SpacePhase=1,
; SpaceMode=1): the space-station docking phase ("DOCK WITH SPACE STATION",
; "PREPARE TO DOCK"; observed in redirect scenario S07). In the final mission
; the same slot is the enemy-base attack (S09). First call (ShopStage=0)
; decodes the space-station graphics into CHR $0900 with the RAM RLE decoder,
; loads palettes and text and installs FlightFrame; later calls (ShopStage=1)
; Per-frame docking work: moves the station into view (HudSplitDelay counts
; down to $18), runs bank 3 slot $0C, sets scroll and continues in the HUD
; Runs after docking: uploads the plane tiles; Select/Start or the end of the
; palette fade (PaletteFadeStep=$8E) leaves for the results/briefing screen
; with phase code 0 (next mission). Otherwise waits for NMI.
; Shop screen ("NEXT MISSION / WEAPONS ... CREDITS"): starts song 2, loads the
; shop graphics and text pages, initialises the cursor and installs ShopFrame.
; Main in-mission frame handler (ground flight, space battle and docking).
; First half (vblank work): pending plane-graphics upload, palette and HUD
; updates (score, credits, weapons, speed), scroll registers, engine and wind
; sound, one-shot sound requests. Second half: reads joypads, pause, mission
; stage logic, flight model (speed, pitch, roll, altitude, take-off/landing),
; bullets, plane sprite, objects (bank 3), HUD sprites and the sprite-0 split.
; Ends by jumping to HudSplitAndWait or a phase-specific tail.
; HUD (screen page 1): speed digits and score every frame; lives/bombs/
; missiles and credits on alternate frames.
; even frames: lives, hawk bombs, maverick count
; odd frames: phoenix count and credits
; engine note: pitch follows altitude (or the jet chase in missions 2/6)
; MissionStage reached $81: rebuild the terrain around the enemy base (27 rows)
; with the scroll position at the base section.
; during the base attack only Start is honoured
; While MissionEndMode is set the mission is over: input is reduced to Start
; and the plane is forced into a climb (PitchStep 6, Pitch $26). Climbing
; above Y $14 then ends the ground mission with code $88 (Flight_Steering).
; Observed in redirect scenario S07 after setting MissionStage to the
; Objective reached in terrain section $44 (carrier approach) or $2C (carrier
; deck): instead of climbing out, an autopilot keeps the plane invulnerable,
; limits input to Start and steers it down onto the landing marker;
; UpdateGroundObjects (bank 3) then sets MissionEndMode=1 and the usual
; climb-out follows. Missions 4 and 8 (index 3 and 7) are the carrier missions
; that start on the $2C deck. Observed in redirect scenario S11 (mission 4,
; approach $44 wrapping to deck $2C, plane landed, then the briefing).
; PauseState: Start toggles pause (APU muted while paused)
; space battle finished: results screen with code $44 (docking next)
; debug: controller 2 holding B+Up on the ground forces the climb-out (MissionEndMode=1)
; GroundUnder + PlayerY >= $90 means the plane touches the terrain
; Speed moves toward Throttle through SpeedFrac (0-99 per unit)
; missions 2 and 6: Select + Up/Down sets the throttle
; altitude follows ClimbRate smoothed through ClimbSmooth/ClimbSmooth2
; final mission: the base explodes after MissionStage $40, then results
; Docking approach with the space station (SpacePhase 1, SpaceMode 1, not the
; final mission). Pressing B starts the docking sequence: CrashState counts
; $75..$7E every 8 frames, then the plane must be inside the docking window
; (PlayerX $62-$6D, PlayerY $3A-$45) at the right station animation phase,
; otherwise CrashState=$80 (crash). A successful dock waits 16 frames and
; enters the shop. Confirmed in redirect scenario S08 (PlayerX $67/PlayerY $3F
; debug: controller 2 holding B+Up skips docking straight to the shop
; docking sequence: CrashState $75..$7E, one step per 8 frames
; A single "jmp GameOverFadeStart" between the end of the docking check
; (Flight_DockFailed ends with its own jmp) and Flight_DockedWait. No branch
; or table reaches it. Probably a dead jump left from an older docking-failure
; path that ended the game directly. Static only; reachability unresolved.
; FlightFrame continued (after the no-caller jump at $9843): 16-frame wait
; after a successful dock (AttractTimer reused as the counter), entry to the
; shop, vertical scroll speed and bullet dispatch.
; docked: ShopStage=$FF, EndingFlag=1, then ShopInit (observed in S08)
; vertical scroll speed = f(Speed) from SpeedToScroll
; "If LaunchActive is clear go to Flight_FireButtons, otherwise skip to
; Flight_AfterBullets": would stop the cannon firing during the carrier
; launch. The live path above reaches Flight_FireButtons through its own
; branches and never enters here, so the check is bypassed. Static only.
; FlightFrame continued (after the bypassed check at $98C6): ground cannon.
; A pressed fires immediately; A held repeats after FireDelay
; Disabled terrain palette tweak. Flight_AfterBullets above ends with
; "lda SpacePhase / bne Flight_Steering / jmp Flight_Steering", so both
; outcomes skip exactly this block, whose own exit is Flight_Steering.
; TerrainPos high byte < 4; it takes World X / 4 and, for values $20-$8F,
; writes colours $2A,$1A,$01 to palette buffer entries PaletteBuf+1..+3,
; otherwise $27,$17,$01. Probably an abandoned colour change for one terrain
; area. Statically classified; never reached in any trace.
; World X outside $20-$8F (or TerrainPos too far): the alternate colour triple.
; Climb-out check and steering. PlayerY above $14 ends the ground mission
; (phase code $88, results screen). Then roll/drift, auto-centering after idle
; frames, pitch from Up/Down, PitchStep = Pitch/6 and the turn latch.
; free Left/Right: roll faster at higher speed
; plane sprite frame from Roll and PitchStep (PitchFrameBias)
; FramePhase counts 2,1,0; on wrap pick the next plane frame
; crashing: speed drops and the crash animation advances
; plane sprite tile numbers alternate between two VRAM tile sets
; "stx FramePhase" just before Flight_PlaneSprites, after a "jmp
; Flight_PlaneSprites". Same encoding as the store at Flight_PhaseStep;
; probably the remains of an earlier fall-through into the sprite code.
; Hides the plane's 22 sprites, then (unless the title flag AttractTimer is
; set) places them from the plane frame layout (PlaneLayoutLo/Hi via Ptr0):
; per sprite a Y and X offset relative to PlayerX/PlayerY; negative frames
; are mirrored. Also sets the plane palette (normal, crash flash) and draws
; move left; at the left limit the world scrolls instead
; Take-off from the carrier: draws the catapult sprites, raises the plane until
; sprite 0 (split marker) and the altitude marker
; recompute HUD speed digits only when the value changed
; Unreferenced fill: 98 x $EA between the flight code (Flight_ToSplit) and
; Fill: 98 bytes of $EA (phase 1: uniform run, no code entry).
; Sprite-0 split: waits for the sprite-0 hit, then switches to screen page 1
; (HUD nametable), resets scroll and burns HudSplitLine-$B8 scanlines (via
; DelayScanline) before blanking. Then dispatches to the docking/shop/space
; tails or waits for the next NMI. Entered with Y = PPUCTRL value.
; Ground flight: run bank 3 slots $03 (terrain scroll) and $06 (objects); then
; bank 3 slot $2A (upload terrain row) and restore the plane sprite 0.
; FramePhase 0: redraw the docking station; otherwise move the warp cells
; Space-phase cannon: like the ground cannon but bullets fly into the screen
; Game-over fade: uploads the palette buffer, sets scroll and darkens the
; palette every fourth frame; after 32 frames continues with GameOverScreenInit.
; Shares the sprite-0 split wait at GameOverFade_Split.
; "GAME OVER"/"CONTINUE" screen: clears nametable 0, keeps the best score of
; this game in GameBestScore, prints the continue prompt (Continues > 0) or
; the plain game-over text (GameOverTexts), loads its palette, starts song 5
; and installs ContinueFrame with a 10-step countdown in Temp0.
; copy the score to GameBestScore if it is higher
; Continue countdown: shows the remaining count, decrements it every 32
; frames. Start (while music still plays) uses a continue: restarts the
; current mission phase with 5 lives and zero score. When the count runs out
; or no continues remain the high-score entry check follows (HighScoreCheck).
; ground mission: Mission-1 because MissionStart increments it
; FrameHandler = FlightFrame (writes A, not Y: value is the code, see note)
; Converts GameBestScore to the high-score table format, then compares it
; with the nine rows stored in nametable VRAM (HighScoreRowAddr). If it
; qualifies, the lower rows are shifted down (ShiftHighScoreRows), the score
; is written into the new row and name entry starts (HighScoreEntryInit);
; otherwise the high-score table screen (HighScoreTableShow) follows.
; No new entry: shows the table and returns to the attract scene.
; Shop frame handler (bank 3 palette cycling, attributes highlighting the
; cursor row, page text via the ShopPagePtrs command lists, credit display,
; item-count icons). Up/Down moves the cursor; A/B/Start selects: page
; commands $FB-$FE buy an item if Credits suffice (cannon 10, Maverick 2,
; Hawk bomb 5, Phoenix 2), $FF leaves the shop (ShopExit), other values
; Leaves the shop for the next mission's launch: loads the carrier/flight
; graphics, resets the music state, places the plane on the deck and installs
; Silences all APU channels, sets DMC/frame-counter/channel-enable registers
; and clears the sound driver state ($0406-$04A6 area).
; NMI (bank 0 vector). If a frame handler is still running (NmiBusy) only the
; sound driver runs (NmiSoundOnly). Otherwise: PPUCTRL from PpuCtrlShadow,
; bank 0 screen page 0, rendering off, OAM DMA from $0200, stack reset to $FF
; and jmp (FrameHandler) - every frame handler starts on a fresh stack.
; Y/X = low/high of the next frame handler. Falls into WaitForNmi.
; Marks the frame finished (NmiBusy=0), enables NMI and spins at NmiSpin
; until the NMI handler takes over.
; Moves part of PendingScore into the score digits: 10 per call when 512+
; remain, 7 when 64+, otherwise 1. Clamps PendingScore at 0 and adds the
; amount to the decimal digit string (ScoreDigits, tiles $F6-$FF) with carry.
; Uploads the background and sprite palettes from PaletteBuf (entry 0 of each
; Writes the four background palettes from PaletteBuf to PPU $3F00.
; Writes the four sprite palettes from PaletteBuf+$10 to PPU $3F10.
; Waits for vblank and writes 32 bytes of BootPalette to PPU $3F00.
; Waits for vblank and copies 32 bytes of FlightPalette into PaletteBuf (used at mission start and after the shop).
; Waits for vblank and writes GameOverPalette (32 bytes) to the PPU.
; Writes TitlePalette (32 bytes) to the PPU (caller has waited for vblank).
; Writes ShopScreenPalette (32 bytes) to the PPU.
; A/X = PPU address (hi/lo), Y = index into TextPtrTable. Writes the string:
; characters minus $40 (space -> tile 0); the last character has bit 7 set.
; Pseudo-random step mixing FrameCounter into RandomState; result in A and
; Gives star X a new random phase, direction, speed and resets its position to
; the centre; the direction quadrant decides which coordinates are negated.
; "lda #$00" falling into StarReset_Position. StarRespawn ends with
; "jmp StarReset_Position", skipping exactly these two bytes, so this looks
; like an alternate entry that would reset a star to position zero instead of
; a random one. No caller found; static only.
; StarRespawn continues here with A = random 0-7, jumping over the two
; no-caller bytes at $B091 (BypassedStarResetZero). Stores the start position
; and negates coordinates according to the direction quadrant.
; Adds the speed entry Y (StarStepHi/Lo) to star X's X position; respawns the
; star when it crosses the edge.
; Subtracts the speed entry from star X's X position (respawn at the edge).
; Adds the speed entry to star X's Y position (respawn below the horizon).
; Subtracts the speed entry from star X's Y position (respawn above the top).
; Initialises all 32 stars (random or radial layout depending on StarMode).
; Sets attribute $40 (horizontal flip) on the 21 plane sprites from OamIndex.
; Clears the attribute byte of the 21 plane sprites from OamIndex.
; Writes 16 of the 32 stars (alternating halves each frame) into OAM
; $02C0-$02FF: position, tile by phase and distance, palette.
